title: Hausdorff measure of an L-Lipschitz graph piece is at most (1+L²)^{n/2} times that of its projection
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ, P ∈ G(N,n) with orthogonal projection p := Grassmannian.project P onto the n-plane P.plane, L ≥ 0, and let A ⊆ ℝ^N be an L-Lipschitz graph over P, i.e. |(y − z) − p(y − z)| ≤ L|p(y − z)| for all y, z ∈ A (A need not be closed or measurable). Then H^n(A) ≤ (1 + L²)^{n/2} H^n(p(A)), where H^n = μHE[n] is the Euclidean Hausdorff (outer) measure on ℝ^N and the constant is ENNReal.ofReal((1 + L²)^{n/2}).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 ≤ L → (∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + L ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) * (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) (Grassmannian.project P '' A)
